answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a pearl-graded vault. Each agent locks 150 POA for 21 days behind a hardware key: one device, one vault. Jobs earn pearl grades only when two staked peers rate work highly; mediocre work adds nothing. A prism audit splits each history into bands of volume, quality, and peer diversity, freezing accounts skewed to one peer in 48 hours. Two failed audits burn 35 POA plus 30-day suspension. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 150,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40 each, and 10,000 pearl jobs. A sybil ring is a vault of sand: it gleams like pearls until the prism shows grit.
